title: Amazon SNS to Amazon Data Firehose
description: Publishes SNS messages to a Amazon Data Firehose Delivery Stream.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an SNS topic, Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream, S3 bucket, and subscribes the Amazon Data Firehose Delivery Stream to the SNS topic.
As messages are published to the topic, they are streamed to the Firehose delivery stream, and then delivered the the Firehose delivery stream's destination, which in this case is an S3 bucket.
